notes.title: NEW WARFARE has now a PATREON !
notes.notes: After many thoughts, we decided that it will great to have a donation system because a lot of people wanted to pay the game but we wanted it to remain free-to-play. We chose [url=https://www.patreon.com/waverisestudios/membership]Patreon [/url]to be the simplest possible ever. All the posts on the patreon will be publicly viewable by everyone. See you on NEW WARFARE !

notes.title: NEW WARFARE now has a discord server !
notes.notes:
After some insane stats for New Warfare and numerous comments on the STEAM community section we decided that, to create a big community, we needed a [url=https://discord.gg/6FAjqFa58h][i][b]discord server[/b][/i][/url]. This way everyone can share their opinions about the game and help in its development. By this we mean that you can be part of beta testing and write suggestions on what we need to add to maybe one day compete with [i]Call Of Duty Modern Warfare 2019 experience[/i]. Also we had a [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvAuKHXLbcyPRvkdg9mu2lQ]Youtube Channel[/url] for a while so that way you can see progress of the game without actually playing it if you don't want.
Hope you will spend a good week,
Best Regards,
WaveRise Studios's Team.
